registration.validator_notes: Phase 3.1 (D4): NO stereotaxic template registration has been computed. Earlier affine_linear_12dof / uncertainty 1.2mm / dice 0.85 values were unmeasured and have been removed. Canonical axes are +X Right, +Y Superior, +Z POSTERIOR (NOT RAS, NOT MNI).

spatial.subfield_mapping_notes: Phase 3.1 corrected: the asset is a CONCATENATED MULTI-SHELL COMPOSITE of 14 BodyParts3D component chunks (16 disjoint closed shells measured), NOT a continuous pial surface. Individual gyral/sulcal boundaries are chunk seams, not validated anatomy; sulci are NOT resolved as geometry. Corrected component identities (5/side were mislabeled pre-3.1) in docs/PHASE_3_CORTEX_SOURCE_COMPONENTS.md. Microscopic subfields (Brodmann, Julich-Brain) are not physical sub-meshes.
spatial.centroid_convention: bounding-box center (NOT vertex mean). Applies to source_centroid and registered_centroid.
